items.title: TFI chief Bedard rips into its US LTL operations, promises change
items.content_html:
Alain Bedard, the CEO of TFI International, had been highly critical of his company’s U.S. LTL operations back in 2024, at one point referring to some of its practices as “stupid.” As recently as April, he was far more optimistic about the segment that was built largely through the TFI acquisition of UPS Freight in […] The post TFI chief Bedard rips into its US LTL operations, promises change appeared first on FreightWaves.

items.content_html:
